title: Hearing Kemp in a restaurant and sitting in at night clubs
summary: As a schoolboy he hears Hal Kemp and takes the train to sit in at Brooklyn nightclubs.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: I remember going to the Mangrove Grill at that time to hear Hal Kemp. We used to go to the Chinese restaurant for lunch and they'd always have a band playing. Sometimes they were pretty good.

I used to go to Brooklyn to sit in, at nightclubs, when I was a kid; I used to take the railroad, sleep all night in the Erie Railroad station in Hoboken, get the morning train back home and go to school the next day.
You were a pretty precocious kid.
I guess so, looking back at it.
